question.text:
Match List-I with List-II -
$\begin{array}{|l|l|l|l|}
\hline & \begin{array}{l}
\text { List-I } \\
\text { (Separation of) }
\end{array} & & \begin{array}{l}
\text { List-II } \\
\text { (Separation } \\
\text { Technique) }
\end{array} \\
\hline \text { (A) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Aniline from } \\
\text { aniline-water } \\
\text { mixture }
\end{array} & \text { (I) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Simple } \\
\text { distillation }
\end{array} \\
\hline \text { (B) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Glycerol from } \\
\text { spent-lye in soap } \\
\text { industry }
\end{array} & \text { (II) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Fractional } \\
\text { distillation }
\end{array} \\
\hline \text { (C) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Different } \\
\text { fractions of crude } \\
\text { oil in petroleum } \\
\text { industry }
\end{array} & \text { (III) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Distillation } \\
\text { at reduced } \\
\text { pressure }
\end{array} \\
\hline \text { (D) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Chloroform- } \\
\text { Aniline mixture }
\end{array} & \text { (IV) } & \begin{array}{l}
\text { Steam } \\
\text { distillation }
\end{array} \\
\hline
\end{array}$
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

solution.text:
(A) Aniline $-\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}$ : Steam Distillation
(B) Glycerol from spent-lye in soap industry - Distillation under reduced pressure
(C) Different fraction of crude oil in petroleum industry - Fractional distillation
(D) $\mathrm{CHCl}_3-$ Aniline - Simple distillation
